responsibility: Declares the incremental hashing interface for RTL expressions. Its public role is to expose inchash::add_rtx so other RTL infrastructure can fold structural rtx content into hash::hash state for lookup tables, canonicalization helpers, and memoized analyses.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public RTL hashing entry point inchash::add_rtx for use by other RTL code; unlike gcc/rtlhash.cc, it does not implement the recursive hashing of rtx structure.
